command.description: Command to run before (or instead of) TFTP upload

target_ip.description: IP address to assign to target device

interface_ip.description: IP address to assign to selected interface

blind_mode.description: Blind mode (don't wait for response packets)

remote_filename.description: Remote filename to use during TFTP upload

interface.description: Network interface directly connected to device

netmask.description: Subnet mask to assign to target device

timeout_upload.description: Time (seconds) to wait after successful TFTP upload

tftp_port.description: Port to use for TFTP upload

region.description: Set device region (NA, WW, GR, PR, RU, BZ, IN, KO, JP)
